method: In-process kev.checkpoint.load + model.probs on one request with 22 TypeScript rules (hygiene + practices); median of 3 warm runs. 'one_row_per_pass' patches kev.mlx_model.rows_per_pass to return 1.
note: Kev's MLX path already batches all question rows of a request in one pass (budget 16,384 tokens). Absolute times are higher than the served numbers because other processes were running; the ratio is what matters.
